version: Team values, added after PRD Rev C (scope change 3B)
note: Body-system rules give Advisory or Caution only. They never give Warning. They do not count toward the radiation alarm budget (M-3). Thresholds are team values for the demo. They are not NASA flight rules.

rules.title: Radiation sickness signs
rules.text: Nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea within 48 h after a dose event. Tell the CMO now.

rules.title: Vision change
rules.text: Blurred near vision or eye pressure. Do the near-vision check at the next exam.

rules.title: Vision change continues
rules.text: Vision symptoms on 2 days in a row. Ask the CMO for an eye exam.

rules.title: CO2 headache
rules.text: Headache with a stuffy head, short breath, or dizziness. Check the cabin CO2 reading.

rules.title: Short sleep
rules.text: Sleep under 6 h on 3 of the last 3 check-ins. Talk to the CMO about the sleep plan.

rules.title: Low mood
rules.text: Mood 2 of 5 or lower on 3 of the last 5 check-ins. A private talk with the CMO or the flight psychologist can help.

rules.title: Resting heart rate out of range
rules.text: Resting heart rate is above 100 or below 40 bpm. Tell the CMO now.

rules.title: Resting heart rate rise
rules.text: Resting heart rate is more than 20 bpm above your 7-day mean.

rules.title: Low exercise
rules.text: Exercise under 60 min a day on 3 of the last 7 days. Exercise slows bone and muscle loss.

rules.title: Bruising or bleeding
rules.text: Easy bruising or bleeding gums. Tell the CMO.
